subject: Initial tenant access & API key handoff - Datum Health
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Williams <ava.williams@datumhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial tenant access & API key handoff - Datum Health

Hi Ava —

Congrats again on signing — excited to get Datum Health into a live tenant. This thread is to transition from sales into the implementation kickoff and to capture the immediate access steps so your team can begin integration next week.

Quick plan (high level):
- Monday (6/22): seed admin users + generate two API key pairs (dev / prod).
- Tuesday (6/23): role mapping review, project/namespace layout, and sandbox endpoint test.
- Wednesday (6/24): join initial integration call with our CS engineer.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short mutual action plan and an admin roster template so we can seed accounts. Please confirm the identity we should add as the primary admin (name + email) and whether you need KMS/HSM key custody.

Open questions for you:
1) Do you want Redwood to generate API keys and store them in your Vault, or will you generate keys on your side and provide public metadata?
2) Any IP allowlist ranges we should add ahead of time?
3) Compliance contact for SOC2 evidence and audit windows.

If helpful I can drop a calendar for a 30-minute kickoff with Monica (CS Engineer) and Ben (SE) — we have 10:30–11:00 PT slots available on 6/23 and 6/24.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ava Williams <ava.williams@datumhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@datumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial tenant access & API key handoff - Datum Health

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:

- Primary admin: Michael Chen <michael.chen@datumhealth.com> (Infrastructure Lead). He’ll be our point for seeding and API key handover.
- We prefer Redwood to generate API keys and then we will rotate into our Hashi Vault; can you provide an exportable key bundle/metadata?
- IP allowlist: 34.82.12.0/24 and 35.188.0.0/16 (we’ll confirm if more are required).
- Compliance: I’m looping in Michael for SOC2 evidence coordination; our auditor is external-audits@datumhealth.com but we don’t need full evidence until the end of Q3.

Please proceed with the admin roster as attached. 6/23 10:30 PT works for us.

—Ava
Ava Williams
Director of Product | Datum Health

Subject: Implementation kickoff: admin seed, roles, and API handoff

Hi Ava / Michael —

Thanks Jordan. I’m Monica, your Customer Success Engineer at Redwood — I’ll run the initial tenant activation and the integration checklist with you. To keep the kickoff efficient, I’ve put together a concise checklist (attached as datum_admin_roster.csv and the onboarding map). Proposed agenda for 30m on 6/23 10:30 PT:

1) Quick intros + agenda (5m)
2) Confirm admin accounts + ownership for API key lifecycle (5m)
3) Project/namespace naming (dev / staging / prod) and role templates (10m)
4) Short test: generate dev API key, call sandbox endpoint, validate token headers (8m)

Ownership & immediate asks:
- Redwood (Monica): seed two admin accounts, generate dev API key, and share key metadata (expiry, fingerprint).
- Datum (Michael): confirm admin email, confirm IP ranges to allow.

KMS note: We support vendor-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS) or Redwood KMS-managed keys. If you choose BYOK, share the KMS key ARN and we’ll provide the required wrapping metadata.

Attachments referenced: datum_onboarding_map.xlsx / datum_admin_roster.csv / mutual_action_plan.docx

If you prefer a slightly longer 45m slot (so we can run the test live and triage), say the word — otherwise I’ll send the 30m calendar invite for 6/23 10:30 PT.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference

Quick add from engineering side:

- Sandbox quota: I’ll bump the dev quota for Datum Health to 5000 tokens/minute for the first 2 weeks so integration tests don’t hit throttles.
- Test plan: I’ll publish a short Postman collection to the shared Drive link so your infra team can run token/latency checks.
- SDK keys: If you plan to use our SDK, let me know language preference (Python / Node / Java). I’ll include a short snippet for rotating keys programmatically.

I’ll be on the 6/23 call to help with the dev key test.

—Ben

Thanks everyone — short summary and owners so it’s easy to follow up:

- Michael: confirm final admin roster in datum_admin_roster.csv (owner: Michael Chen) — due 6/20 EOD.
- Monica: seed two admin accounts and generate dev API key, share metadata to Datum vault (owner: Monica) — target 6/22.
- Ben: upload Postman collection and SDK snippet to shared Drive (owner: Ben) — target 6/22.
- Jordan: create mutual action plan entry in HubSpot and confirm deal handoff is complete (owner: Jordan) — target 6/21.

Meeting: 6/23 10:30 PT (30m) — calendar invite sent. Please flag if you want the 45m option.

We’ll keep all artifacts in the Drive folder (link above) and I’ll attach the final MAP once I sync with Legal for the signature block.

If any blockers appear (e.g., BYOK details, IP lists, or SOC2 evidence requests), please reply-all so we can triage.
